author: trackreco
body:
#### PR description:

This PR improves the mkFit final fit (`trackingMkFitFit`) by addressing main open items since its first implementation:
1. pT bias;
2. lack of TrackExtras and Trajectories as output.
Eventually, this update shall allow for mkFit to replace CKF final fit in all its applications. However, the default configurations are not changed in this PR.

Main changes:
- Geometry and plane propagation: Phase-2 module boxes and stacks are described correctly, and each module carries its own material. Plane propagation and the Kalman update are split into reusable steps.
- Fit physics: the field constants of the fit are fitted to the CMS field map, the field is taken at the step midpoint and its radial component is included. Energy loss and multiple scattering are applied per crossed module. The ad-hoc pT calibration of the final fit is removed. Track building uses the ParabolicMf constants from `portableParabolicMagneticField::Parameters`.
- Numerics in single precision: covariance update in Joseph form, plane Jacobian without cancellation at small bending angles, outlier removal also for the first and last hit (as in the CKF fit), and failed fits flagged as such.
- Outputs: smoothed states at every hit, full TrackExtras and Trajectories, and the hits removed by the fit stored as lost hits, as for the CKF fit. The MTD track extension can then run on these tracks.

With the procModifier `trackingMkFitFit`, initialStepTracks are produced by the mkFit final fit and `MkFitOutputTrackConverter` instead of the CKF fit. Offline the converter also stores the per-hit states and Trajectories; at the HLT this requires `trackingMkFitFit & mtd_at_hlt`. The fit options are `FinalFitFlags` in `PropagationConfig`, set by `MkFitGeometryESProducer`. Track finding changes only through the shared plane steps and Jacobian, at the level of float rounding.

Contributions from Matev Tadel, Leonardo Giannini and Gavin Niendorf.

For more details: https://indico.cern.ch/event/1743564/#9-update-on-mkfit-fit

#### PR validation:

Comparisons of reference release and this PR ttbar PU200, same events and configurations, CPU-only (bit-reproducible).
HLT: 300 events; offline: trackingOnly, 100 events.
Efficiency, fake and duplicate rates in tables below are defined as in standard MTV. The pT bias and resolution are measured with respect to simulated prompt pions with pT > 1 GeV.

| HLT, hltGeneralTracks | old mkFit fit | this PR | CKF fit |
|---|---|---|---|
| efficiency / fake / duplicate rate | 90.23 / 1.13 / 0.87 % | 90.83 / 0.92 / 1.00 % | 90.66 / 0.85 / 0.92 % |
| pT bias | -0.144 % (with its calibration) | -0.035 % | -0.061 % |
| pT resolution, \|eta\| < 0.3 / 1.2-1.6 | 0.822 / 1.393 % | 0.729 / 1.389 % | 0.780 / 1.525 % |

| Offline | CKF fit | this PR (mkFit fit) |
|---|---|---|
| initialStep by original algorithm: efficiency / fake rate | 69.88 / 1.20 % | 69.91 / 1.31 % |
| generalTracks: efficiency / fake rate | 92.11 / 11.37 % | 92.08 / 11.48 % |

MTV plots: [HLT](https://mmasciov.web.cern.ch/TRKPOG/MkFitFit/PR_HLT/), [offline](https://mmasciov.web.cern.ch/TRKPOG/MkFitFit/PR_offline/).

Furthermore:
- The output tracks are bit-identical with and without per-hit states.
- The per-hit states agree with TrajectoryStateCombiner to 2e-4 (relative, worst case).
- The MTD extension runs on these tracks without warnings.

Timing, including per-hit states and Trajectories: 
HLT, mkFit final fit plus converter = 76 ms per event, against 240 ms for the CKF fit; 
offline: 140 against 739 ms.
mkFit track finding is also about 10% faster, thanks to the shared plane steps.

FYI: @cms-sw/tracking-pog-l2, @slava77, @osschar, @GNiendorf
title: mkFit final fit: fixing bias and adding extras and trajectories
